<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import {
  NavigationMenuRoot,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type NavigationMenuRootEmits,
  type NavigationMenuRootProps,
} from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NavigationMenuRootProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  // Base UI's `delay` of 0: panels open as soon as the pointer reaches a trigger.
  delayDuration: 0,
  as: "nav",
  orientation: "horizontal",
  skipDelayDuration: 300,
  unmountOnHide: true,
})
const emits = defineEmits<NavigationMenuRootEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegated, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="navigation-menu"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('group/navigation-menu relative flex w-full flex-col', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </NavigationMenuRoot>
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { injectNavigationMenuContext } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()
const menu = injectNavigationMenuContext()
const open = computed(() => !!menu.modelValue.value)
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-slot="navigation-menu-backdrop"
    role="presentation"
    :data-state="open ? 'open' : 'closed'"
    :class="
      cn(
        'pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-0 hidden bg-background/40 backdrop-blur-sm data-[state=open]:block',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  />
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { injectNavigationMenuContext, injectNavigationMenuItemContext, Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/** Goes inside NavigationMenuTrigger, e.g. around a ChevronDown; turns over while its panel is open. */
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  as: "span",
})

const menu = injectNavigationMenuContext()
const item = injectNavigationMenuItemContext()
const open = computed(() => menu.modelValue.value === item.value)
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="navigation-menu-icon"
    aria-hidden="true"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :data-state="open ? 'open' : 'closed'"
    :class="cn('ml-1 inline-flex size-3 transition duration-200 data-[state=open]:rotate-180', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { NavigationMenuLink, type NavigationMenuLinkEmits, type NavigationMenuLinkProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { navigationMenuLinkVariants, type NavigationMenuLinkVariantProps } from "./variants"

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    NavigationMenuLinkProps & {
      class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
      variant?: NavigationMenuLinkVariantProps["variant"]
      /** Close the menu when the link is chosen. */
      closeOnClick?: boolean
    }
  >(),
  { variant: "default", closeOnClick: true, as: "a" },
)
const emits = defineEmits<NavigationMenuLinkEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, variant: _variant, closeOnClick: _closeOnClick, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

function onSelect(event: CustomEvent<{ originalEvent: Event }>) {
  emits("select", event)
  // Reka closes the menu on select unless the event is prevented.
  if (!props.closeOnClick) event.preventDefault()
}
</script>

<template>
  <NavigationMenuLink
    data-slot="navigation-menu-link"
    v-bind="delegated"
    :class="cn(navigationMenuLinkVariants({ variant }), props.class)"
    @select="onSelect"
  >
    <slot />
  </NavigationMenuLink>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
/**
 * Renders the popup inside the NavigationMenu element by default, as the React version
 * does. Pass `container` (an element or a selector) to teleport it elsewhere.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
  container?: string | HTMLElement | null
  disabled?: boolean
  defer?: boolean
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <Teleport v-if="props.container && !props.disabled" :to="props.container" :defer="props.defer">
    <slot />
  </Teleport>
  <slot v-else />
</template>
